items.item: The NumPy-vs-Arrow nullable-numeric reveal is a genuine finding, not assumed from the string-dtype result: both Int64 (NumPy-backed) and int64[pyarrow] (Arrow-backed) use the identical pd.NA sentinel, so the axis that actually matters for missing-value semantics is nullable-extension vs. not, which the reveal states explicitly rather than implying numpy-vs-arrow always differs
